arguments:
set +e
echo REA_LOW_COST_AUDIT_BEGIN
echo AUDIT_USER=$(id -un)
echo APP_DIR_STATUS
test -d /srv/lowcost-europa; echo app_directory_exists=$?
git -C /srv/lowcost-europa rev-parse HEAD 2>&1 | head -c 180
echo
git -C /srv/lowcost-europa status --porcelain=v1 2>&1 | head -n 10
echo LOWCOST_SERVICES
systemctl list-units --all --type=service --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'lowcost|gunicorn|nginx|postgresql' | head -n 24
echo LOWCOST_TIMERS
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'lowcost|restic' | head -n 20
echo HTTPS_SMOKE
curl --max-time 12 --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out 'root=%{http_code} sslverify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n' https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/ 2>&1
curl --max-time 12 --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out 'readiness=%{http_code}\n' https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/health/ready/ 2>&1
curl --max-time 12 --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out 'robots=%{http_code}\n' https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/robots.txt 2>&1
echo REA_LOW_COST_AUDIT_END
